description: Capability self-description still works after the v6.8.4 typed-handler migration (Phase 2.A.2 moved this to lookup_capabilities_typed).
Two-turn baseline — greeting on turn 1, capability query on turn 2.  Tests that the cascade handles independent turns cleanly without state leaking.

PROBE — gap: procedure anaphora.  After a procedure query, a bare follow-up «Қанша қадам бар?» («how many steps?») should resolve against the just-retrieved procedure and answer with the step count.  Currently the cascade has NO anaphora binding for procedures (Phase 2.E.2 only wired Person referents for lifespan), so this falls through to the v6.1 layer.  Closes the loop once a `last_procedure_id` referent is added.

PROBE — gap: typed procedure-attribute query.  After a procedure query, «Кім жауапты?» («who is responsible?») should surface the `authorization` field of the just-retrieved procedure.  Needs a typed attribute-extraction layer on top of procedure anaphora.

PROBE — gap: PropertyQueryIR.  The Phase 2.E.2 anaphora layer only wired one property (lifespan).  A follow-up «Қайда туылды?» («where was [he] born?») after a biographical query should resolve to the same referent and surface the BornIn modifier — requires generalising the lifespan-shape detector to typed PropertyQueryIR.
PROBE — gap: PropertyQueryIR (occupation slice).  Same shape as birthplace_after_lifespan_anaphora but probes IsA / occupation extraction.

PROBE — gap: stable cross-language coherence within one Conversation.  User starts in Kazakh, switches to Russian on turn 2.  adam should answer in either language coherently — but currently the language detector inside `interpret_text` is per-turn, so cross-turn coherence isn't enforced.  Probe checks adam answers turn 2 at all (response non-empty) rather than asserting language because the desired behaviour is still under discussion.

PROBE — gap: bare «Жоқ.» without an alternative.  After a name statement, just saying «Жоқ.» should prompt for the correct name («Атыңызды қайта айтыңызшы»), not just acknowledge.  Currently no such prompt exists — the cascade falls through to the default «Жоқ» refusal template.
